config.latitude: Latitude used to calculate prayer times on your machine.
config.longitude: Longitude used to calculate prayer times on your machine.
config.method: Prayer time calculation method. Times are calculated on your machine with [adhan-js](https://github.com/batoulapps/adhan-js).
config.level: How many azkar to include. You can also switch from the checklist.
config.level.full: Full, the complete Hisn al-Muslim set
config.language: Interface language. `auto` follows VS Code's display language. The dhikr text is always Arabic.
config.notifications: Show a reminder every 30 minutes while a session is incomplete.
config.breakAfterMinutes: Minutes of active coding, with the session incomplete, before an **Azkar break** prompt.
config.snoozeMinutes: Minutes of active coding a snooze postpones the prompt by. Two snoozes are allowed per session; after that the prompt returns on every editor change.
config.name: Name of your location, for display only (e.g. `Cairo, Egypt`). Use **Azkar Guard: Set location** to pick a city or detect it.
config.deprecated: Replaced by latitude/longitude. Use **Azkar Guard: Set location**; existing values are converted automatically.
